headline: Setting the FY27 tax factor and a $3,000,000 transfer of FY26 certified free cash to FY27 revenues.
summary: Three orders from Mayor Sarno are listed. They cover a stabilization transfer for the tax levy, a $3,000,000.00 transfer of FY26 certified free cash to FY27 estimated revenues, and the FY27 tax factor.
items: Stabilization transfer for tax levy, treasury bills interest
Transfer of FY26 certified free cash to FY27 estimated revenues, $3,000,000.00
